# markdownlint-cli2 scenario fixtures

`test/` is a copy of the `test/` directory of [markdownlint-cli2](https://github.com/DavidAnson/markdownlint-cli2) v0.22.1 (commit `996abf60411a8d954288ac9856aae7602b80cbda`), minus its `snapshots/` directory. It is distributed under the MIT license of the original project (see `LICENSE`).

`scenarios.json` combines the scenario definitions from the original `test/markdownlint-cli2-test-cases.mjs` with the expected output from `test/snapshots/markdownlint-cli2-test-exec.mjs.md`. Both files are generated by `scripts/dump-cli2-scenarios.mjs` and consumed by `crates/cli/tests/cli2_scenarios.rs`. See `docs/cli2-scenarios.md` for the scenario list and the exclusions.
